response.diary: Fri Jan 9: Val texted that they're sick with fever and cough. I feel fine but am masking in crowds and keeping distance, and I texted Val and Oli. Sticking with classes and studying.

messages.text: Oh no Val, so sorry you're feeling awful! Rest up and let us know the test result. I'll keep my distance, let me know if you need anything dropped off.
Heads up Oli, Val has flu-like symptoms and is getting tested. Watch for symptoms and maybe mask up when we study.

response.thoughts: Val is sick with flu-like symptoms. I feel fine and tested negative, but I was flagged as a contact earlier. I'll still go to class and keep my routine, but wear a mask in crowded places, and reply kindly to Val. I'll keep distance and watch symptoms. I'll skip nothing major, but study in Green less late tonight.
